meta.title: Conversation notebook
meta.description: Choose Conversation notebook from the right sidebar guide to manually edit a separate note for each conversation. New notes start blank. Each edit writes synchronously in this browser on this device; Desktop uses the stable dsh-app://app origin to retain notes across restarts. Clearing browser data deletes notes. Tabs using the same note follow last-write-wins; another tab can overwrite text even while the editor is focused.
